$comment: Canonical capability manifest. v4 adds codeExecution with code_execution_unavailable and tool_calling_unverified (TOOL_RUNTIME_DESIGN.md §6.11). The TypeScript module (src/lib/effective-capabilities.ts) and the generated Swift contract (native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoCore/Generated/JunoCapabilityContract.swift) BOTH derive from this file, so the two cannot drift apart by construction — there is nothing to keep in sync, only one thing to change. Regenerate Swift with: node scripts/generate-capability-contract.mjs --output=native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoCore/Generated/JunoCapabilityContract.swift

capabilities.summary: A thinking effort the model applies before answering.
Search the web and cite sources.
Deeper 'pro' execution on the same model id, independent of reasoning effort.
Read images supplied with the message.
Call connector tools during the turn.

Show a connector action that needs a person's decision and answer it with the receipt digest it was shown with. A client without this surface cannot complete a turn that reaches one, because the broker holds the tool call until somebody answers.

Run Python, JavaScript or a shell script in a sandbox with no internet during the turn, and see the real output, exit status and produced files. Offered only with a configured, healthy sandbox and a model whose tool calling has been verified.

degradationKinds.summary: A different model answered than the one requested.
degradationKinds.note: Recorded first: it is the degradation a user notices in the bill, and it causes the others.

degradationKinds.summary: The reasoning effort was lowered to what the model accepts.
The model has no reasoning effort at all.
Web search was requested but did not run.
Fast mode was requested but the model has no faster tier.
Pro mode was requested but the model has no pro execution mode.
Images were supplied but the model cannot read them.
Connectors were requested but did not run.
An action needed a person's approval and this client has nowhere to ask, so the action did not run.
degradationKinds.note: The one kind here that is a refusal rather than a lesser answer: the others still produce a reply, this one leaves a connector call unexecuted. A client that cannot render the approval has to say that the action was dropped, because the alternative it would otherwise fall into is a turn that reads as finished while the send, the delete or the calendar invite silently never happened.

degradationKinds.summary: Running code was asked for but the sandbox is not available, not configured, or not allowed for this chat or plan, so nothing ran.
degradationKinds.note: The reply must say plainly that nothing ran rather than show code as if it had run.

degradationKinds.summary: Running code was asked for but this model's tool calling has not been verified by a live round trip, so it was not offered.
degradationKinds.note: Recorded per model in contracts/capabilities/tool-runtime-coverage.json. An untested model is never marked compatible.
